extraction_notes: SI Table S1 was excluded because it reports equilibrium values, not catalyst measurements. SI Figure S2 was excluded because it is CO hydrogenation rather than CO2 hydrogenation. Characterization-only figures and tables were excluded. Values read from SI figures are approximate and marked with qualifier '~'; exact 250 °C conversions from SI Section 5 were used instead of the corresponding plotted bars in SI Figure S4.
